method: Physical phone interaction through ADB, raw device screenshots, and recorded cold-launch frames

checks.name: Cold launch enters gameplay
checks.observation: After force-stop, am start -W reported LaunchState COLD. The Unity splash and loading transition led directly into Level 4, without the original home/start screen.

checks.name: Fruit and tree alignment
checks.observation: Level 4 remaining fruit and Level 5 complete fruit layout appeared on their respective tree canopies without visible overall displacement. Four background regions in the before/after cold-start screenshots had identical RGB pixels in an independent read-only comparison.

checks.name: Single victory settlement
checks.observation: Matching the final Level 4 fruit opened one new Level Complete screen. The original WinUI did not appear. Plain Claim showed the existing short reward receipt, then gameplay advanced to Level 5.

remainingPopupsObserved: A Lucky Reward popup appeared before the final match and was claimed.
A short reward receipt appeared after claiming the Level Complete reward.
Level 5 displayed NEW TOOL UNLOCKED for the extra slot. Claiming it returned to clean Level 5 gameplay. This was a tool-unlock popup rather than a second victory settlement.
limitations: This is a test of the existing save on one physical device, not a fresh-install or all-level test.
Fruit idle animation changes the visual fruit bounds slightly.
The settlement recording ended early; the screenshot sequence is the evidence for the complete claim-to-next-level transition.
finalPhoneState: Level 5 gameplay, new-tool unlock popup claimed
